Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 8161 ( Part XI ) - 1983 

Indian Standard 

GUIDE FOR 
EQUIPMENT RELIABILITY TESTING 

PART XI FLOW CHART DESCRIBING PREPARATIONS 
FOR AND EXECUTION OF RELIABILITY TESTS 

0, FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard ( Part XI ) was adopted by the Indian 
Standards Institution on 25 January 1983, after the draft finah'zed by the 
Reliability of Electronic and Electrical Components and Equipment 
Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electronics and Tele- 
communication Division Council. 

0.2 This standard which is the eleventh in the series of Indian Standards 
for equipment reliability testing and covers diagrammatic guidance to 
the test specification writer and test engineers on how to use the other 
standards in this series. A list of standards envisaged in this series is 
given below: 

IS : 8161 Guide for equipment reliability testing: 

( Part I )-1976 Principles and procedures 

( Part II ) Design for test cycles ( under preparation ) 

( Part III ) Preferred test conditions for equipment reliability 

testing ( under consideration ) 

( Part IV ) Procedure for determining estimates and confidence 

limits from equipment reliability determination 
tests ( under preparation ) 

( Part V )-r98l Compliance test plans for success ratio 

( Part VI )-1983 Tests for validity of a constant failure rate assump- 
tion 

( Part VII )-1977 Compliance test plans for failure rate and mean 
time between failures assuming constant failure 
rate 

( Part VIII ) Tests for validity of a non-constant failure rate 

assumption ( under consideration ) 

3 



IS: 8161 (Part XI) -1983 

( Part IX ) Compliance test plans assuming WeibuU distribution 

of times to failure ( under consideration ) 

( Part X ) Compliance test plans assuming normal distribution 

of times to failure ( under consideration } 

( Part XI )-i983 Flow chart describing preparations for and execu- 
tion of reliability tests 

©•3 This standard is largely based on I EC Document 56 ( Central 
bSce ) 73 Draft — lEC^Piiblication 605: Equipment reliability testing, 
Part 1 1 Flow chart describing preparations for and execution of reliability 
tests, issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission. 

0*4 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this 
standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, 
expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with 
IS : 2-1960*. The number of significant places retained in the rounded 
off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this 
standard. 



i. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard ( Part XI ) gives diagrammatic guidance for prepar- 
ing, executing and interpreting equipment reliability tests specified in the 
other parts of guide for equipment reliabihty testing ( see 0,2 ), 

2. CONTENTS 

24 A sequence of steps for preparing the detailed reliability test specifi- 
cation necessary before starting an equipment reliability test is given in 
Fig 1. A sequence of steps for executing and interpreting the test is 
given in Fig 2. At each step, reference is made to applicable clauses of 
IS : 8161 ( Part I )-1976t and to applicable other parts of this series of 
standards.
